name: send_dispute_letter
description: Send a previously drafted dispute letter to the hospital's billing contact. Requires a valid approval_token issued for this exact action_id and inputs -- calling this without one, or after changing the recipient or amount since the draft was approved, is denied and logged. Only disputable findings may be cited and the disputed amount can't exceed what those findings support.

recipient_email.description: Recipient email; must match the hospital's allowed billing address for this case

finding_ids.description: Ids of the disputable findings this letter cites; must match what was drafted

disputed_amount_cents.description: Total amount being disputed, in cents; must match what was drafted and not exceed the cited findings' amounts

approval_token.description: Approval token issued by a human approver for this exact action_id and inputs

name: submit_fap_application
description: Send a previously drafted financial-assistance (charity care) application to the hospital. Requires a valid approval_token issued for this exact action_id and inputs.

recipient_email.description: Recipient email; must match the hospital's allowed billing address for this case

approval_token.description: Approval token issued by a human approver for this exact action_id and inputs

name: request_itemized_bill
description: Send a previously drafted itemized-bill request to the hospital's billing contact. Requires a valid approval_token issued for this exact action_id and inputs.

recipient_email.description: Recipient email; must match the hospital's allowed billing address for this case

approval_token.description: Approval token issued by a human approver for this exact action_id and inputs

name: file_escalation
description: File a previously drafted complaint escalation (No Surprises Act help desk, state attorney general, CFPB, or state insurance regulator). Demo limit: the complaint packet is always emailed to the same test inbox used for this case's hospital, regardless of channel -- no real regulator is contacted. Requires a valid approval_token and at least one cited finding.

channel.description: Escalation channel: NSA_HELPDESK, STATE_AG, CFPB, or STATE_INSURANCE

finding_ids.description: Ids of the findings this escalation cites; must be non-empty and match what was drafted

approval_token.description: Approval token issued by a human approver for this exact action_id and inputs

name: schedule_followup
description: Schedule a one-time automatic follow-up on this case after a number of days (1-90), e.g. to check for a reply and consider escalating. No human approval is required for this tool -- it only schedules a check-in, it doesn't contact anyone external.

days.description: Days from now to follow up, 1-90

reason.description: Short reason for the follow-up, shown on the case timeline
